crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/ca.contract: Cached files use regular-file bounded reads (64 MiB maximum per file, final symlinks rejected on Unix). Original OCI manifest JSON is capped at 16 MiB and strict external I-JSON before descriptor projection. Manifest digest, exact layer count/media and each descriptor digest/size gate admission. JSON decode does not replace Sigstore verification; ancestor custody and write atomicity remain separate.

crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/ma.contract: The complete 16 MiB-bounded original native guard manifest is duplicate-aware before marketplace Value and typed projection. Full-width native prices survive; nested duplicate keys reject. Existing price and reputation checks remain separate.

crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/oc.contract: Referrer index, artifact manifest and token responses use strict original external I-JSON under a 16 MiB transport cap. Guard download delegates to descriptor-bounded transport, including digest-pinned manifests; Sigstore blobs preflight descriptor size/digest and cap actual retention. Errors do not echo response bodies. Registry Basic credentials cannot be delegated to a different token-realm authority. Sigstore authenticity remains a distinct gate.

crates/guards/chio-guards/src/embedding_.contract: Unsigned patterns are bounded to 16 MiB before duplicate-aware original document decoding and embedding projection; ordinary float spellings such as 0.10 and 1.0 remain valid; file input is a regular-file bounded read with Unix final-symlink rejection. Native IO and parser sources survive without input echo. Existing dimensions/finite-number and model checks remain.

crates/guards/chio-wasm-guards/src/block.contract: The persisted blocklist uses a 1 MiB bounded regular-file read and native original JSON validation before its closed wire type. Digests must be explicitly present and already canonical. Writer size matches reader size; corrupt or missing-shape state cannot silently become an empty blocklist.

crates/guards/chio-wasm-guards/src/hot_r.contract: Canary manifest and fixture files use 1 MiB bounded regular reads, with at most 32 declared/discovered canaries before file loading. Original native fixture and nested verdict JSON is duplicate-aware. IO and parser causes remain source-bearing, and failed evaluation still prevents swap.

crates/guards/chio-wasm-guards/src/manif.contract: Manifest YAML and integrity sidecars use 1 MiB bounded regular reads. YAML Value parsing rejects duplicate mappings before typed projection; JSON sidecars validate original native JSON. Only actual NotFound can mean optional sidecar absence; other IO failures reject. WIT, digest and signature validation remain separate.

crates/guards/chio-wasm-guards/src/runti.contract: Wasm module files are capped at the existing 10 MiB module limit before retention. Structured guest denial JSON validates original bounded native bytes before typed projection and no longer reinterprets malformed JSON as plaintext. Existing Wasmtime fuel/memory/import/result constraints remain; a denial cannot become Allow.

crates/security/chio-cage-init/src/boots.contract: Reviewed existing bootstrap contract: sealed descriptor input uses MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES bounded read, typed native decode then exact canonical re-encoding equality before envelope authentication, peer, binding and enforcement checks. crates/security/chio-cage-plan/src/model.contract: Reviewed existing FdPurpose custom deserializer: closed tagged wire variants reject unknown sibling fields even for unit purposes, then map into the public enum. crates/security/chio-cage/src/launch/lin.contract: Reviewed existing bounded status-pipe decoder: line bytes are capped before decode and exact canonical StatusRecord equality precedes protocol stage handling and prepared enforcement validation. Parsing status alone cannot mint launch authority. No native host enforcement qualification is inferred.

crates/security/chio-decoy/src/materiali.contract: Persisted Unix path bytes now decode through BoundedVec with a 4096-byte maximum. crates/security/chio-decoy/src/registry..contract: Reviewed existing decoy custody: bounded EncryptedDecoyEnvelope and authenticated decryption precede canonical plaintext decoding; exact typed re-encoding, schema, tenant/artifact and materialization receipt identity validation follow.
